arms bent and raised holding or presenting objects

justification: Both depict a single elaborately adorned anthropomorphic figure in relief, wearing a tall ornate headdress, with bent arms holding attributes and with bracelets and patterned garment detail — a generic correspondence of 'ornate ritual figure'. But A shows a winged, bearded figure strictly in profile facing a stylised plant with rosettes, while B shows a rigidly frontal, wingless figure entirely enveloped in dense glyph-like ornament with no separate scene element; the rendering conventions (long parallel-line feather and hair combing versus blocky interlocking mask-scrolls) share nothing specific.
